universe_ew_benchmark.note: Equal-weight buy-and-hold of the long leg's own 15-symbol universe, captured at study start (raw closes 2026-08-07). This is the fair benchmark for the long leg: the 2026-08-22 strategy-validation study found ~85% of the 20d-momentum rule's backtested OOS gains came from universe composition (NVDA/TQQQ/MSTR), and EW of the same universe beat the rule risk-adjusted (Sharpe 1.85 vs 1.27). EW return = mean over symbols of (current_price/ref - 1).
